Context / business driver:
- Product team needs sub-100ms 95th percentile latency for live chat personalization in EU. Typical request sizes small (avg 120 tokens).
- Embeddings for on-site search: batch index updates nightly, high throughput; cost sensitivity for embedding ops.
- Must commit to data residency (EU) and audit logs for GDPR compliance.

History / timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-11-12: inbound demo request from marketing site form (AE assigned: Evelyn).

- Concerned about cold-start latencies when moving to Dedicated; want baseline 95p <120ms.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to reduce embed costs.
- Audit/logging retention: 18 months for call traces, 7 years for compliance events (legal team pushing).

- Run 2-week POC: week 1 hosted in eu-west to profile latency; week 2 dedicated staging in customer VPC to measure real tail latencies and KV cache behavior.
